### Changed
- **agentgateway in front of muster is the default topology: `ingress.mode: agentgateway-muster`, `components.agentgateway.enabled: true` and `agent-platform-mcps.agentgateway.viaMuster: true` in both charts (was `muster-direct`, off, `false`)** (giantswarm/agent-platform#252). The topology the platform is developed, demonstrated and documented against is now what a plain install gets: MCP traffic on `/mcp` goes through the agentgateway data plane to muster, while OAuth discovery and everything else stays on muster's `/` route. Installations that set the three keys explicitly are unchanged. A release without muster (a serving or runtime slice) has no ingress topology and renders no data plane whatever the mode; a slice beside the platform's release sets `components.agentgateway.enabled: false`, as the slice examples do. `muster-direct` and `agentgateway-direct` are deprecated; removing them is a later major release.
